enabled.name: Feature riders
enabled.hint: Elemental Adept, Elemental Affinity, Potent Spellcasting, Healer and Battle Medic are applied automatically. Turn off to go back to doing them by hand.

hdControls.name: Hit Dice − / + on character sheets
hdControls.hint: Shows a − and a + beside Hit Dice on the character sheet outside edit mode, to spend or regain one Hit Die.
